difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian scheme S with dualizing complex omega_S, f : X -> S of finite type with normalised dualizing complex omega_X, the lemma asserts that delta_X(x) - delta_S(f(x)) = trdeg_{kappa(f(x))}(kappa(x)) for all x in X, where the delta are the dimension functions of the two dualizing complexes (statement lines 5855-5889). The proof reduces to an affine neighbourhood of x, then to a compactification X in Xbar over S, then to X proper over S, and finally to X connected by replacing it with the component of x (proof lines 5891-5900). It then observes that both delta_X and the function x -> delta_S(f(x)) + trdeg_{kappa(f(x))}(kappa(x)) are dimension functions on X by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-dimension-function-propagates, using that S is universally catenary by Lemma labelled lemma-dimension-function-scheme, so by Topology, Lemma labelled topology-lemma-dimension-function-unique their difference is locally constant hence constant as X is connected, and it suffices to check equality at one point (proof lines 5902-5912). Properties, Lemma labelled properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-closed-point provides a closed point x of X, whose image s is closed in S since X -> S is proper, and then Lemma labelled lemma-good-dualizing-normalized gives the equality (proof lines 5914-5916). Reducing to a connected proper scheme and then comparing two dimension functions at one closed point is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
